domain_setting: A clean produce market with fresh vegetables arranged on a wooden counter, a pale cool wall, and a few natural leaves. Keep each vegetable large and recognizable, with a cut face only when it clarifies its identity.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 card with essential content inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Use generous clear space and bold silhouettes for produce names
Use leaves, stems, cut sides, florets, and seeds to distinguish similar vegetables
No labels, lettering, numbers, package marks, or text

polysemy_resolution_table.pepper / peppers: Bell peppers in the vegetable group, following the neighboring tomatoes and squash; not black pepper spice.
polysemy_resolution_table.avocados: Edible avocado fruit used as produce in this vegetable lesson, not an animal or tree.
polysemy_resolution_table.beans: Green edible bean pods, distinct from round peas.
polysemy_resolution_table.corn / sweetcorn: A sweet corn cob eaten as a vegetable, not a field of grain.
polysemy_resolution_table.vegetables: A mixed group of vegetables rather than one specific item.

contrast_notes.broccoli / cauliflower / cabbage / lettu: Broccoli is a branching green floret head; cauliflower is a pale compact curd; cabbage is a tight round layered head; lettuce has loose leafy layers.
contrast_notes.potato / sweet potatoes / carrot: Potato is a brown-skinned starchy tuber; sweet potatoes are elongated copper roots with orange or purple flesh; carrots are tapered orange roots with leafy tops.
contrast_notes.cucumber / zucchini / butternut squash: Cucumber is long dark green and seedy; zucchini is darker and shorter with subtle stripes; butternut squash has a narrow neck and bulbous seed cavity.
contrast_notes.beans / peas / corn: Beans stay in long green pods; peas are separate round green spheres in an opened pod; corn has a golden kernel grid on a cob.
contrast_notes.onion / garlic / leek: Onion is a round bulb with papery skin; garlic is a segmented bulb and cloves; leek is a long white-green stalk with fan leaves.
